Both added. Refresh http://maker:4001/preferences.html — the list now shows **5 per page** with a pager, and **⚙ Preferences** has two new controls.

**Please try:**
1. **Paging.** The list shows "**Showing 1–5 of 8**" with **‹ Prev / Next ›** below it. Click **Next ›** to see the rest.
2. **Bookmarks per page.** Open **⚙ Preferences → "Bookmarks shown per page"** and try **10**, **25**, or **All** (the pager disappears when everything fits). Set it back to a small number to see paging again.
3. **Text size.** In Preferences, switch **Text size** between **Small / Medium / Large** → titles and descriptions resize live across the list.

So display preferences now cover: **appearance (Light/Dark/Match system), list density, text size, show/hide previews, bookmarks per page, which view to open on, default sort, and auto-save copies.**

Does that complete the basic display preferences for you?
